name: scheduler
description: Rooms, bookings, recurring events, conflict detection and reminders for an office calendar.
author: test-split author (Claude, independent of the reviewer code)

issues.anchor: return self.start <= other.end and other.start <= self.end
issues.description: Intervals are half-open and the docstring says touching intervals do not overlap, but <= makes a 9-10 meeting clash with a 10-11 one, so back-to-back bookings are refused.
issues.fix_hint: Use strict comparisons: self.start < other.end and other.start < self.end.

issues.description: The default holiday set is created once and stored as is; add_holiday mutates it, so a holiday added to one calendar closes every calendar built with the default.
issues.fix_hint: Default to None (or an empty tuple) and store a fresh set(holidays).

issues.description: book takes (room_id, organizer, title, interval) but book_series passes title and organizer the other way round, so every meeting of a series is organized by its title and reminders go to the wrong name.
The user-typed export name is joined to the export folder unchecked, so a name like ../../x writes an .ics file anywhere the process can write.
issues.fix_hint: Reject names with path parts (or keep only the base name) and check the resolved path stays inside export_dir.

issues.description: bookings imports reminders to create reminders when booking, and reminders imports bookings for Booking, Status and Calendar; the two modules depend on each other.

issues.description: Office hours (8:00, 18:00) and the 15-minute slot are literal numbers repeated in bookings._check_office_hours and finder.free_slots instead of shared constants.
